title: A Bethe-Ansatz Source of Early Token Correlations: A marginal-preserving construction for parallel proposals
abstract: arXiv:2610.16781v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Parallel token proposals need a joint law, not merely accurate token marginals. We construct coordinate-Bethe-ansatz laws from the periodic XXZ chain and compare them with their maximum-entropy pairwise projections at identical one- and two-site moments. In an eight-site, three-excitation sector, symmetry makes the full probability-law difference one-dimensional, determined by a contiguous three-site moment $\delta$. Along the Bethe branch, this gap changes sign and vanishes exactly at $\Delta=(3+\sqrt3)/2$, where the eigenstate law becomes pairwise. A nonlinear two-token readout preserves separate token marginals yet exposes a distance $2|\delta|$; a direct three-token readout preserves all one- and two-token marginals yet exposes $4|\delta|$. At $\Delta=1.5$ these deterministic binary distances are $0.02654573$ and $0.05309145$. We give an exact target-alignment formula and prove a strict speculative accepted-prefix advantage throu

translated_title: 早期Token相关性的贝特拟设来源：一种用于并行提议的保持边际分布的构造方法
translated_abstract: 并行token提议需要一个联合分布律，而不仅仅是精确的token边际分布。我们从周期XXZ链构造坐标贝特拟设分布律，并在相同的一站点与二站点矩条件下，将其与最大熵成对投影进行比较。在一个八站点、三激发扇区中，对称性使得完整的概率分布律差异是一维的，由一个连续的三站点矩 δ 决定。沿贝特分支，这一差距会改变符号，并恰好在 Δ=(3+√3)/2 处消失，此时本征态分布律变为成对独立的。一个非线性双token读出在保持各自token边际分布的同时，暴露出距离 2|δ|；一个直接的三token读出在保持所有一token与二token边际分布的同时，暴露出 4|δ|。在 Δ=1.5 时，这些确定性二元距离分别为 0.02654573 和 0.05309145。我们给出了一个精确的目标对齐公式，并证明了一个严格的投机解码接受前缀优势。
tldr: 该论文从周期XXZ链的坐标贝特拟设构造出保持token边际分布的并行提议联合分布律，并证明即使一、二token边际完全匹配，由 δ 量化的高阶相关性差异依然存在，从而揭示了早期token相关性的可积系统来源。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs joint laws for parallel token proposals from the coordinate Bethe ansatz of the periodic XXZ chain, proving that even when one- and two-token marginals match exactly, higher-order correlations quantified by δ remain detectable, thereby revealing an integrable-systems source of early token correlations.
